description: This file defines the ContextDefinitionInterface, a PHP interface for context definition objects in Drupal, including methods for managing labels, descriptions, data types, constraints, and validation.

classes.name: ContextDefinitionInterface
classes.description: Interface for context definition objects in Drupal, specifying methods for label, description, data type, constraints, and validation.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the human-readable label of the context.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the human-readable label of the context.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the context, or NULL if none.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the context.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Retrieves the data type needed by the context.

methods.name: setDataType
methods.description: Sets the data type needed by the context.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the context data is multi-valued.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Sets whether the context data is multi-valued.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the context data is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the context data is required.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Retrieves the default value for the context.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the context.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves validation constraints for the context.

methods.name: setConstraints
methods.description: Sets validation constraints for the context.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a validation constraint to the context.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Retrieves a specific validation constraint by name.
